stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 38 pts for Glen White, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 5 & 18 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 4 & 8 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Don't Mind Me
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 11 - just casually

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 20 on the back nine after 14 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 87 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: A warm country welcome to Taylor Bentley, visiting us today from Bankstown GC.

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 11, 12 & 13 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 8-11

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Nothing But Ones
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - zero wipes is something to hang your hat on

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 11 & 12 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 9, 3-pointer on hole 10 - that's better

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 10 & 11 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 7 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 10 & 11 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 12 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 5 wipes from 10 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 4 & 5 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 5 & 6 - feast then famine

stories.title: Playing Off the Wrong Card
stories.detail: A 27-marker up at 8th - the handicapper's pen is twitching

comingLast.roast: off 8 and famous for the wrong reasons - 24 does that
one decent hole (13 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Webster
on 14 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
6 holes of runway left - 8 points clears the fence
1 point clear from the bar - watching Webster like a hawk with a beer
2 above Webster and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
